title: Protective and pathogenic functions of macrophage subsets

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Protective and pathogenic functions of macrophage subsets》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Macrophages are strategically located throughout the body tissues, where they ingest and process foreign materials, dead cells and debris and recruit additional macrophages in response to inflammatory signals.
